_comment: Facts that docs/pipeline-drawings.html asserts about this tree. `drawings.py check` compares each against live source; `refresh` rewrites the mechanical ones. Mirrors .claude/skills/run-sol/baselines.json. After republishing, run `refresh` and commit -- skip it and the post-commit hook warns forever.
title: Sol Pipeline Drawings
_watch_comment: Files whose movement can invalidate a plate. evaluator/ is excluded on purpose -- it is vendored and bench.py test already diffs it against the organizer's copy. hard-rules.md is excluded because rewording cannot be told from a rule change.
_bm25_from: starter/retrieval.py:76 -- Plate 3 renders this as prose, so a sweep breaks the caption too
_symbols_comment: Existence only, never line numbers: pinning a line makes every insertion above it a false positive. The paths are the human breadcrumb.
_doc_literals_comment: Catches the opposite rot -- someone hand-edits the HTML and these pins go stale.
_score_comment: Plate 5. Checked only by `check --score`, never by the hook: the catalog is gitignored and a missing one scores 0.0 silently, so an automatic check would report a fake regression on every fresh clone.
